T: Riddle me this. What's for dinner.
D: Batman takes on the Riddler and Two-Face while taking in a young circus acrobat named Dick Grayson.
P: Serve the snacks when the Flying Graysons take to the trapeze at the circus.
S: the circus where the Flying Graysons perform

Popcorn tossed with melted butter and a little caramel, poured into red and white striped cones. Pop 100g popping corn in a large lidded pot. Melt 50g butter with 50g brown sugar until bubbling and toss through the popcorn with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Spread out to cool for 5 minutes, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

Two sliders per plate: a beef and cheddar slider with pickles, and a crumbed chicken slider with slaw, decided by a coin toss. Shape 400g beef mince into 4 small patties and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar for the last minute. Cut 2 chicken breasts into 4 flat pieces, coat in flour, egg and panko, and shallow fry 3 minutes a side. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon. Toast 8 slider buns. Fill 4 with beef, pickles and tomato sauce, and 4 with chicken and slaw.

Soft chewy pretzels twisted into question marks, dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked brown, with hot English mustard. Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark, with a small ball of dough for the dot. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each piece for 30 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with English mustard.
M: Wayne Manor eye fillet with red wine jus

Beef eye fillet seared and roasted pink, with a glossy red wine jus, creamy potato gratin and grilled asparagus. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, 2 garlic cloves and salt, and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 250ml red wine and 250ml beef stock in the pan until reduced by half and whisk in 30g butter. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and a sticky sweet chilli sauce, served in takeaway boxes.
W: the trapeze act at the circus
Batter piped in swirls into hot oil, fried golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with berries.
K: Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top. Pour a splash of lime cordial into each tall glass and top up with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and fizzes up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before the foam spills over.

s.how: Pop 100g popping corn in a large lidded pot. Melt 50g butter with 50g brown sugar until bubbling and toss through the popcorn with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Spread out to cool for 5 minutes, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark, with a small ball of dough for the dot. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each piece for 30 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with English mustard.

m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a hot wok until browned. Add a sliced red capsicum and cook for 2 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce and 2 tbsp soy sauce until sticky, then pack into takeaway boxes.

w.note: the trapeze act at the circus
w.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and a spoon of sugar into a smooth batter. Pipe in looping swirls into 180C oil and fry until golden on both sides. Drain on paper, dust thickly with icing sugar and serve warm with sliced strawberries.

d.how: Pour a splash of lime cordial into each tall glass and top up with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and fizzes up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before the foam spills over.
